title: Erdős 68 factorial-gap channel lcm: the Stirling radius constraint and its square-subsequence lower bounds

concepts.label: channel lcm through D
concepts.note: channelLCM D is the least common multiple of d! - 1 over 2 <= d <= D.

concepts.label: channel radius hypotheses
concepts.note: A positive integer M divisible by the channel lcm through the depth and smaller than (R+1)! - 1. The three conditions are theorem binders in this module; they are not derived from the factorial-gap series.

concepts.label: square subsequence D = 2t^2
concepts.note: The reparameterisation of the channel depth by D = 2t^2, under which the radius lower bound is cubic in t.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Let t, M and R be naturals with 4096 <= t, 0 < M, channelLCM (2t^2) dividing M, and M < (R+1)! - 1, where channelLCM D is the least common multiple of d! - 1 over 2 <= d <= D. Then t^3 < 8(R+1). In sequence form, for functions M and R satisfying those three conditions at every t >= 4096 there is no T with 8(R(t)+1) <= t^3 for all t >= T, and the sequence R(t)+1 is not o(t^3) along the filter at infinity.
statement_nodes.engine: a Stirling lower bound on log channelLCM (2t^2) against the factorial-gap upper bound at radius R, specialised at k = 2t and D = 2t^2 and compared through the binomial identity 3*C(2t+1,3) + t = 4t^3
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The prior-art relation for the channel-radius family is recorded as unassessed in the claim frontier, so no novelty is asserted here.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The three channel conditions are theorem binders. This release does not derive divisibility of M by channelLCM (2t^2), or the bound M < (R+1)! - 1, from the factorial-gap series of Erdős 68, and no statement here decides rationality of that series.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the same three channel conditions imposed from the larger threshold 2^32 <= t, namely 0 < M, channelLCM (2t^2) dividing M, and M < (R+1)! - 1, the sharper bound 3t^3 < 2(R+1) holds, that is R+1 > (3/2)t^3. In sequence form, for functions M and R satisfying those conditions at every t >= 2^32 there is no T with 2(R(t)+1) <= 3t^3 for all t >= T.
statement_nodes.engine: the same Stirling radius constraint with the optimised logarithmic comparison, whose constant is absorbed by the threshold 2^32 through 32 log 2 <= log t
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The prior-art relation for the channel-radius family is recorded as unassessed in the claim frontier, so no novelty is asserted here.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The improved constant is bought with the larger threshold 2^32. The little-o form is proved only in the cubic regime at threshold 4096, and no statement here derives the channel conditions from the factorial-gap series or decides its rationality.

intra_zone_relations.basis: Neither statement contains the other. The three-halves bound has the larger constant, 3t^3/2 against t^3/8, and the larger threshold, 2^32 against 4096, so its channel conditions are imposed on a smaller range of t. The cubic regime is the one that carries the little-o form.
